skill.name: convex
skill.description: Routes general Convex requests to the right project skill. Use when the user asks which Convex skill to use or gives an underspecified Convex app task.
skill.summary: Routes broad Convex app requests to the most specific Convex workflow skill.
skill.author: get-convex

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Convex routing guide with no evidence of malicious prompt injection or data exfiltration. Two external command recommendations are real medium-risk behaviors because npx can download and execute package code, while most other backtick matches are Markdown formatting or skill names. One remote rules-file URL is a low-risk supply-chain concern because it may load external AI guidance.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends running an external npx command before Convex work.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running the command, and tell users to verify the Convex package source.

remediation.issue: The fallback rules file is loaded from a remote URL.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted Convex guidance when possible, and document that remote rules may change over time.

content.value_statement: Convex tasks often need the right workflow before coding starts. This skill routes broad requests to setup, auth, component, migration, or performance guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes underspecified Convex app tasks to a more specific Convex skill.
Recommends installing or refreshing managed Convex AI guidance before project work.
Points users to Convex AI documentation and a fallback rules file.
Identifies quickstart, auth, component, migration, and performance workflow matches.
Explains when to stop using this routing skill and switch context.
limitations: Does not implement Convex features directly.
Requires other Convex skills for detailed workflow execution.
External guidance installation may require user approval.
Does not verify project state automatically.

use_cases.title: Start a Convex Project
use_cases.description: Route a new app request toward quickstart guidance and current Convex AI setup.

use_cases.title: Triage a Broad Request
use_cases.description: Choose the correct Convex workflow when a task lacks enough detail.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Specialized Work
use_cases.description: Send auth, component, migration, or performance work to the correct focused skill.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner routing for an unclear Convex task.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a Convex task: [describe task]. Choose the best Convex workflow skill and explain the first step.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Project Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether the project should update Convex AI guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Convex project context: [context]. Decide whether Convex AI guidance should be installed or refreshed before work starts.

prompt_templates.title: Route a Feature Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Map a feature request to setup, auth, component, migration, or performance guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Route this Convex feature request to the most specific skill: [feature request]. Include any needed clarification questions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Step Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced routing when one request spans several Convex workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Break this Convex project goal into ordered workflow steps: [goal]. Identify which Convex skill should handle each step.

output_examples.input: I want to add Convex to my existing app.
output_examples.output: Use the Convex quickstart workflow. First confirm the framework, then install or refresh Convex AI guidance before implementation.

output_examples.input: I need sign-in for a Convex app.
output_examples.output: Route this to the Convex authentication setup workflow. It should handle provider selection, configuration, and auth-specific project changes.

output_examples.input: My Convex queries feel slow after launch.
output_examples.output: Use the Convex performance audit workflow. Gather the slow functions, query patterns, and recent schema changes before tuning.

best_practices: Check whether current Convex AI guidance is already installed before changing files.
Route to the most specific Convex skill that matches the user request.
Ask a brief clarifying question when one request spans multiple Convex workflows.
anti_patterns: Using this routing skill to implement a full Convex feature directly.
Running external setup commands without user approval.
Treating general documentation links as a substitute for project-specific analysis.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes general Convex requests to the correct specialized Convex workflow skill.

faq.question: Does it write Convex code?
faq.answer: No. It selects the right workflow and starting guidance for Convex work.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a Convex task is broad, unclear, or not tied to one known workflow.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: It references Convex documentation and may recommend external guidance installation.

faq.question: What should happen after routing?
faq.answer: The assistant should switch to the matched Convex skill and continue with that workflow.
